ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle centered at R, and P, M, N, Q are all on the circle. Segment PM passes through the center R, so PM is a diameter. In the figure there is a right-angle mark between RN and RP, so ∠NRP = 90°. In the figure the central angle from RP to RQ is labeled 115°. Reasoning: Because PM is a diameter, arc PM is a semicircle, with measure 180°. Since ∠NRP = 90°, the corresponding arc NP = 90°. On the semicircular arc PNM passing through N, arc MN = 180° - 90° = 90°. The required m arc MNQ is the major arc starting from M, passing through N, and then to Q, consisting of arc MN, arc NP, and arc PQ. Therefore m arc MNQ = 90° + 90° + 115° = 295°.

raw_record.question_text: $\overline{PM}$ is a diameter of $\odot R$. Find $m\widehat{MNQ}$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at R with P, M, N, Q on the circle. From the image, note that PM passes through R, RN is perpendicular to RP, and the central angle from RP to RQ is labeled 115°. From the text, use that PM is a diameter, so arc PM is a semicircle of 180°. Since RN ⟂ RP, the central angle NRP is 90°, so arc NP is 90°. Therefore on the semicircle from P to M through N, arc MN is 180° - 90° = 90°. The requested arc MNQ is the arc from M to Q passing through N, so it consists of arc MN + arc NP + arc PQ = 90° + 90° + 115° = 295°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是以 R 为圆心的圆，P、M、N、Q 都在圆上。线段 PM 经过圆心 R，因此 PM 是直径。图中 RN 与 RP 之间有直角标记，所以 ∠NRP = 90°。图中从 RP 到 RQ 的中心角标为 115°。
推理：因为 PM 是直径，所以弧 PM 是半圆，度数为 180°。由于 ∠NRP = 90°，对应的弧 NP = 90°。在经过 N 的半圆弧 PNM 上，弧 MN = 180° - 90° = 90°。所求 m弧MNQ 是从 M 出发经过 N 再到 Q 的大弧，由弧 MN、弧 NP、弧 PQ 组成。因此 m弧MNQ = 90° + 90° + 115° = 295°。
